purpose: Proof that the semantic knowledge accumulated in V1 and V2 is represented in V3, deliberately superseded, or classified obsolete with a reason. Answers: what happened to concept X?
verificationNote: Verified 2026-09-03 against the corpus and recorded in urn:usf:retention-verification:v1-v2:1. Of the 90 concepts dispositioned RETAIN or MERGE, 87 are present in V3 (24 as a resource, 21 as a predicate, 19 in source, 12 as a type, 11 renamed). Three are not, and all three sit under family-level reasons that name no V3 replacement, which is the exposure methodologyNote already flags. FieldTenancyClassification is mis-dispositioned and should read SUPERSEDE: V3 enforces tenancy at the operation and repository boundary rather than by classifying fields. TokenClaimConstraintTemplate is mis-dispositioned and should read SIMPLIFY: the concrete constraint survives in the authentication platform and only the reusable template abstraction was dropped. ConsentBasis is a genuine gap and is deliberately not re-labelled, because relabelling it to make the retention count clean would assert coverage that does not exist. Separately, the 29 integrity-branch entries all carry one reason claiming compression into the V3 twelve-invariant suite, and only 19 land inside urn:usf:integrity-suite:corpus:1; the other ten are equally enforced but elsewhere, in the work-dependency deriver, the core dependency freshness check, and as graph policy predicates. An operator reading those entries would run the integrity command and wrongly conclude the ten were unenforced. All of this is recorded rather than corrected in place: this ledger states what was decided, and the verification resource states what was confirmed.

dispositionVocabulary.RETAIN: Invariant and its enforcement both carry forward.

v3Families.graph-representation: Blank-node-free N-Quads, IRI convention, declared vocabulary, manifest composition, canonical ordering and quad digesting.
v3Families.semantic-integrity: The twelve whole-corpus invariants enforced by usf graph integrity; a conforming corpus yields zero violations.
v3Families.authority-and-change: Authority generation, explicit supersession, content-pure authority digest, and one bounded semantic transaction.
v3Families.repository-convention: Artefact classes naming canonical location, filename form, authorship, persistence and secret locality.

v3Families.economics: Per transport-and-provider economic eligibility, fail-closed, with catalogue price and explicit operator authorization as the only bases.
v3Families.execution-evidence: One evidence model: request, selection, invocation and result bound by digest, with graph provenance and refusal classification.
v3Families.operational-lifecycle: Hermes operating cycle, terminal dispositions, bounded retry and recovery.
v3Families.validation-confinement: Credential containment, bounded inputs, fail-closed ordering and deterministic validation.
v3Families.work-dependency: Dependency-ready semantic work: declared dependencies between work units and derivation of what is executable now.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: Each IRI kind has exactly one deterministic, mechanically checkable local-name form.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: Lowercase-concatenated local names for the whole corpus, checked by a 994-line whole-dataset SPARQL query.
handAssessed.reason: V2 normalized local names to detect duplicate canonical meaning. V3 compares full IRIs and never normalizes, so the readability cost is unjustified. One form per kind (type PascalCase, predicate camelCase, instance kebab-case) preserves mechanical checkability.
handAssessed.evidence: usf graph integrity checks type/predicate/instance-local-name-style; 0 violations in V3-owned graphs.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: A corpus is only usable if it has no phantom terms, dangling references, ambiguous ownership, self-dependencies or self-warranting derivations.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: One monolithic SPARQL SELECT over a Stardog control plane, run as a publication gate.
handAssessed.reason: 98 branches compress to 12 invariants once ANQR decision-process ceremony (candidate credibility, composition permutation, licence and vulnerability assessment) is separated from universal semantic integrity. No triplestore is required.
handAssessed.evidence: 358 violations found on first run, reduced to 24 recorded legacy items with 0 in V3-owned graphs.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: A derived conclusion must never be authored, and no record may be evidence for itself.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: Derived-only classes confined to urn:usf:graph:derived* graphs, plus a receipt-stability guard that refused to read a receipt's own stable flag.
handAssessed.reason: This is the single most valuable recovered invariant. V3 had no equivalent: nothing prevented authoring an ExecutionResult by hand.
handAssessed.evidence: derivedOnlyTypes enforced by the integrity suite; V3 execution records carry no self-asserted validity flag (C14 check clean).

handAssessed.invariantProtected: The authority digest is a pure function of graph content; no server or environment statistic may enter it.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: Inventory-derived witness with totalSource naming its derivation, replacing a folded-in db.size that made byte-identical content hash differently.
handAssessed.reason: V3 satisfies this structurally: digests are computed from canonical quad text with no external input. Retained as an asserted invariant so it cannot regress.
handAssessed.evidence: canonicalQuadDigest is a pure function of the quad set; reproduced identically in a fresh clone.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: A verdict is a conclusion about exactly one authority state; authority must not move mid-operation.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: Before/after inventory witnesses over every read, re-proved immediately before the first mutation and after the last, with a full rollback stack.
handAssessed.reason: The invariant is real and V3 does not yet satisfy it: graph execution reads catalogue, policy and economics then acts with no proof authority held still. V3 needs a bounded re-check, not a rollback stack, because it mutates no tracked state during execution.
handAssessed.evidence: Confirmed gap: no beforeDigest/afterDigest bracketing exists on the V3 execution path.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: Exactly one implementation decides any given semantic question, and no second path may reach the same effect.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: realisationVerdict as sole implementation plus a structural regression enumerating production modules for forbidden exports.
handAssessed.reason: The archaeology immediately found a live V3 violation: observedAvailableRouteIds existed byte-identically in three command modules.
handAssessed.evidence: Consolidated to one implementation; 0 duplicate definitions remain.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: A consequential state is declared explicitly with a stated basis; an absent or unresolved state fails closed and can never select proceed.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: hasValidationApplicability over a closed five-value set, functional, always with a reason, plus per-state SHACL closure shapes.
handAssessed.reason: V3 already applies the principle in economics (an absent authorization is ineligible). Generalized as an integrity invariant rather than a validation-axis vocabulary.
handAssessed.evidence: evaluateExecutionEconomics returns ECONOMICS_AUTHORIZATION_ABSENT; integrity suite checks state-missing-reason on opted-in graphs.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: An empty result must never be ambiguous between evaluated-and-clean, not-evaluated and withheld.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: actionState on every projection from a four-value set with documented precedence, plus evaluationScope and gapEvaluation fields.
handAssessed.v3Replacement: evaluated:true on integrity and availability reports
handAssessed.reason: V3 partially had this. Both the integrity report and the availability index now carry an explicit evaluated flag so an empty list is unambiguous.
handAssessed.evidence: ObservedAvailability.evaluated and IntegrityReport.evaluated are both literal true.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: Three distinct questions must not collapse into one field.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: Distinct IRIs and distinct gap codes for applicability-reserved versus obligation-reserved, both non-blocking for realisation.
handAssessed.reason: V3 had exactly this defect: a route executing under a free-quota authorization recorded costClass 'priced'. Fixed by recording catalogue price and economic basis as separate facts.
handAssessed.evidence: Result graphs assert both catalogueCostClass and economicBasis.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: A reference denotes one resource or none; ambiguity is a rejection, never a silent first pick.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: Reject unless exactly one distinct contract resolves; no LIMIT 1.
handAssessed.v3Replacement: mappingForRoute cardinality check; deterministic single-candidate selection
handAssessed.reason: V3 already refuses on ambiguity rather than picking. Retained as an invariant.
handAssessed.evidence: candidates.length !== 1 refuses PROVIDERS_RECEIPT_MAPPING_UNAVAILABLE.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: A bounded summary never drops the bad news first.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: openGaps leads ITEM_KEYS and the packet refuses to emit at offset 0 unless the complete gap set fits.
handAssessed.reason: V3 evidence records are unbounded, but classification output is limited. reasonCounts is always complete and never truncated, so refusal reasons cannot be hidden by a display limit.
handAssessed.evidence: summary.reasonCounts covers all 7488 models regardless of --limit.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: A superseded or historical resource is never referenced as current authority.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: Per-family stillcurrent branches across contracts, bindings, decisions, realisations, proofs and evidence.
handAssessed.reason: Directly relevant to V3's own supersession of the legacy provider account lane: without this rule nothing stopped the superseded protocol being read as current.
handAssessed.evidence: Integrity invariant present; supersession declared at urn:usf:supersession:legacy-provider-account-lane:1.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: A rationale record cannot activate a contract, authorise a path or establish semantic truth.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: ADRs carrying an authority witness digest while explicitly disclaiming authority, with live decisions retrieved from Stardog.
handAssessed.reason: V3 keeps the disclaimer as a declared property of the documentation artefact class instead of a per-file preamble plus a witness digest.
handAssessed.evidence: artefact-class:documentation asserts that documentation is never semantic authority.

handAssessed.encodedIn: AGENTS.md; artefactfamily vocabulary (27 families); repositoryexternalartefactmaterialisation ADR
handAssessed.invariantProtected: There is one authoritative declaration of where each artefact belongs, what it is called, whether it is authored or generated, and whether it may hold a secret.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: A materialisation contract plus authority digest plus gateway; writes applied only from bounded plans carrying prior-state digests, path roles, artefact families, formats and file modes.

handAssessed.encodedIn: graph/ontology.ttl: RepositoryDependency, RepositoryWorkPackage, ResolvedWorkPackageDependency, RetainedWorkPackageDependencyLineage, DependencySatisfactionStatus, ActiveRepositoryDependencyBlocker
handAssessed.invariantProtected: Work that depends on other work is not executable until its dependencies are satisfied, and the satisfying lineage is retained.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: A dependency-resolution and satisfaction-policy family with direction, basis kind, disposition and blocker resources.
handAssessed.reason: V1 knew this and V2 dropped it. V3's Hermes currently treats every semantic work unit as independent, so a dependent workload cannot be expressed at all. This is the largest genuine knowledge gap the archaeology found.
handAssessed.evidence: Confirmed: graph-execute extracts work units with no dependency predicate; Hermes dispatches all pending units concurrently.

handAssessed.encodedIn: graph/providers.ttl: 52 Providers with hasProviderMode and fulfilsPort
handAssessed.invariantProtected: A provider is eligible for a workload only if it fulfils the capability the workload requires.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: Provider/mode/port triples with canonicalName, checked by portuncovered and adapterportnotfulfilled integrity branches.
handAssessed.reason: The invariant survives as capability matching against models.dev capability names. Ports were a static hand-maintained abstraction; the catalogue supplies capabilities directly for 7488 models.
handAssessed.evidence: Classification stops candidates at CAPABILITY_MISSING; --require-capability reasoning narrowed 37 routable candidates to 27.

handAssessed.encodedIn: assurance/proofs.trig, cas:// canonicalPath signature objects, publication receipts
handAssessed.invariantProtected: Tamper evidence, actor authorization and non-repudiation across process and trust boundaries.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: Detached signatures over content-addressed objects, publication witnesses and receipt schemas with before/after/settled phases.
handAssessed.reason: V2 signed because Graph, Factory, Operate and Cockpit were separate trust domains handing work to each other. V3 has one operator and one authoritative process, so signatures would authenticate a subsystem handing work to a subsystem that no longer exists. Tamper evidence is retained by content digesting; authorship by tracked commits.
handAssessed.evidence: No V3 execution path consults a signature; provenance is the four-digest chain plus source-assertion digests.

handAssessed.concept: Graph to Factory to Operate handoff
handAssessed.encodedIn: processes/semantic-assurance, agenttaskpacket and contractprojection artefact families
handAssessed.invariantProtected: A semantic transition is atomic, provenance-bearing and recoverable across component boundaries.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: Bounded agent task packets and contract projections regenerated per authority digest, with coordinator fencing and ownership transfer.
handAssessed.reason: There are no longer two independent trust domains. Hermes derives and runs its own cycle in-process; atomicity and provenance are preserved by writing evidence and state after each cycle.
handAssessed.evidence: Hermes completed 7/7 units across 3 self-derived cycles with durable state; a re-run is idle-no-pending-work with zero cycles.

handAssessed.encodedIn: C14 receipt phases; publication witness R5
handAssessed.invariantProtected: Only an authorized actor may atomically change a declared semantic scope, and the resulting state must be reproducible.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: Publication receipts with beforePublication/afterPublication/settled phases, stability derived from phase equality, and a guard that is the sole accessor of current authority.
handAssessed.v3Replacement: one branch, one reviewed change set, one integrity gate
handAssessed.reason: This is the clearest compression case. The invariant reduces to authorized atomic change with reproducible result, which a branch plus the integrity gate plus fresh-state reproduction already provide.
handAssessed.evidence: Fresh clone reproduces classification and graph load with no publication history replayed.

handAssessed.invariantProtected: Authorized change with declared scope, deterministic resulting state, validation, provenance and currentness detection.
handAssessed.legacyMechanism: Nine named stages with persistent intermediate identities and two construction grants per byte delta.
handAssessed.v3Replacement: residual: bounded transaction not yet implemented
handAssessed.reason: Retained for the legacy graphs it still owns. It is not on the V3 execution path and should be replaced by one bounded transaction (propose, derive closure, validate, apply, emit evidence). Recorded as residual debt rather than removed, because nine completed works depend on it.
handAssessed.evidence: The V3 consolidation change set landed as one branch commit without invoking the chain.

methodologyNote: Hand-assessed entries carry an explicit invariant, legacy mechanism, mechanismSurvives flag and evidence. Systematically mapped entries assign a V3 family and disposition by concept domain; they are complete over V2's 495 ontology classes, V1's 39 distinctive classes and V2's 98 integrity branches, but their reasons are family-level rather than per-term. Property-level terms (V2's 1616 owl properties) are covered by their owning family and are not individually enumerated.

repositoryConventionDispositions.currentV3Behaviour: Three coexisting styles: type PascalCase (133/133), predicate camelCase (793 camel vs 74 flat), instance kebab-case dominant; 10 IRI classes internally mixed
repositoryConventionDispositions.discrepancy: No convention was ever declared in V3, so each authoring session chose its own style
repositoryConventionDispositions.rationale: V2 forbade hyphens so normalized local names could be compared for duplicate meaning. V3 compares full IRIs and never normalizes, so that rationale lapsed; but 'one deterministic form per kind' remains necessary for mechanical checking
repositoryConventionDispositions.finalV3Convention: urn:usf:<kind>:<name>[:<version>] with type=PascalCase, predicate=camelCase, any other kind=kebab-case
repositoryConventionDispositions.requiredMigration: Done for V3-owned graphs. Legacy graphs are convention-exempt: renaming would change resource digests of resources owned by completed work

repositoryConventionDispositions.legacyConvention: Era or generation label never occupies the kind segment (implicit in V1/V2; every IRI names a kind third)
repositoryConventionDispositions.currentV3Behaviour: graph/v3-execution.nq used urn:usf:v3:<kind>:<name>, putting an era label in the kind position (19 IRIs)
repositoryConventionDispositions.discrepancy: The consolidation's own graph violated the dominant corpus shape
repositoryConventionDispositions.rationale: A kind segment is what makes an IRI mechanically classifiable; an era prefix hides it and defeats per-kind style checking
repositoryConventionDispositions.finalV3Convention: urn:usf:<kind>:<name>[:<version>]; the era appears in the name where relevant, as in urn:usf:authority-generation:v3:1
repositoryConventionDispositions.requiredMigration: Done: all 19 normalized; iri-segment-shape now 0 in V3-owned graphs

repositoryConventionDispositions.legacyConvention: Owner-oriented layout: tools/ for owned executables, schemas/ for durable definitions, decisions/ for rationale records (V2 ADR)
repositoryConventionDispositions.currentV3Behaviour: graph/, graph/manifests/, schemas/, src/, tests/, config/, docs/, .usf/
repositoryConventionDispositions.discrepancy: V3's layout is consistent in practice but was nowhere declared, and .usf/ accumulated stray top-level files
repositoryConventionDispositions.rationale: The invariant is one authoritative declaration of where each artefact belongs. V2 enforced it with a materialisation contract, authority digest and gateway; V3 needs the declaration, not the gateway
repositoryConventionDispositions.finalV3Convention: 14 artefact classes under urn:usf:convention:repository-layout:1, each declaring canonicalLocation, filenameConvention, authorship, persistence, gitTracked and maySucceedSecret
repositoryConventionDispositions.requiredMigration: Declared. Stray .usf/ items (check-debug-*, tmp-v2-list.txt, recovery-packet.json) are ephemeral and unreferenced

repositoryConventionDispositions.legacyConvention: Authored versus generated separation enforced by artefact family (27 V2 families)
repositoryConventionDispositions.currentV3Behaviour: Tracked authored state under graph/, schemas/, src/, tests/, config/, docs/; generated under .usf/ (gitignored)
repositoryConventionDispositions.rationale: A clean agent must know which files it may author and which are derived output
repositoryConventionDispositions.finalV3Convention: Every artefact class declares authorship as authored, generated or operator-supplied, and persistence as tracked, durable-local or ephemeral

repositoryConventionDispositions.legacyConvention: Secrets confined to an operator-owned location outside Git (V2 credentials boundary)
repositoryConventionDispositions.rationale: A clean agent must know which single location may hold a secret so it never writes one elsewhere
repositoryConventionDispositions.finalV3Convention: Exactly one artefact class asserts maySucceedSecret true: urn:usf:artefact-class:credential-material

repositoryConventionDispositions.legacyConvention: File naming: kebab-case sources, one concern per file
repositoryConventionDispositions.currentV3Behaviour: graph/*.nq kebab, graph/manifests/*.json kebab, schemas/*.schema.json kebab (57), src/**/*.ts kebab, tests/**/*.test.ts
repositoryConventionDispositions.discrepancy: None material: V3 was already consistent here
repositoryConventionDispositions.rationale: Deterministic filenames let an agent locate an artefact without a directory listing
repositoryConventionDispositions.finalV3Convention: Unchanged; now declared per artefact class
